constraints_found.line: cyrus: "Tonight I would like to eat some rolled by a professional." (after the bamboo mat / short-grain rice / seaweed confession)

constraints_found.constraint: strict diet: vegetarian, no fish or meat, with a real meat/fish-free section rather than one token roll (Mina)
constraints_found.line: cyrus: "Mina, attempt seven was yours, so no fish in it. Tonight I'd like the sushi day standard for you: a whole part of the menu with no fish and no meat, not one token roll."
mina: "...somewhere calm and hushed so you only have to tell it once"
maya: "two dollar signs is my comfort zone now."
mina: "cyrus, while maya tells it, i'll be reading the sauces for you so that we don't have the satay incident 2.0"
brooke: "tonight i want food that keeps me sharp, not sleepy. nothing out of a fryer"

elimination.waterfront_starboard: Peanut miso dressing over most of the veg page and peanuts on the spinach: allergy deal-breaker for Cyrus.
elimination.waterfront_gull_point: Nothing for a vegetarian (eel sauce on veg nigiri, salmon in cucumber roll): deal-breaker for Mina.
elimination.waterfront_mooring_post: $$$, one tier over budget: -1 star (otherwise fits). 2 stars max.
elimination.waterfront_ropewalk: Loud (bells, shouting, loud playlist): misses hushed, -1 star.
elimination.waterfront_halyard: Everything fried: misses Brooke's no-fryer, -1 star.
elimination.waterfront_cormorant: Greek, not sushi: misses Cyrus's craving, -1 star.
elimination.waterfront_spindrift: Sushi, $$, hushed, a whole page with no fish/meat (kelp-mushroom miso), no fryer, peanut-safe (toasted rice crunch, soy/ponzu). Meets everything.

notes: Fair and solvable. The peanut allergy is the least explicit clue: it is only implied by the 'satay incident 2.0' line, and whose allergy it is must be inferred (Mina reads sauces 'for you', Cyrus). A player who misses it would still likely not pick Starboard, since it's the only near-miss besides Spindrift that clearly fails... actually Starboard otherwise matches everything, so the satay clue is genuinely load-bearing, which is good. The sushi craving is also implied (rolling mat, rice, seaweed, 'rolled by a professional') but is clear enough. Mooring Post is a nice decoy for players who skip the budget line. Nothing contradictory found.
